title: ObjectUserBody: mass integral access for MarkerBodyMass and LoadMassProportional
author: Claude-JG
description: Maintainer 2026-10-23 (pythonUserItems.md 5.11 E): the user body gets an optional user function for the mass integral of the position Jacobian, int rho J_pos dV (3 x n), together with what MarkerBodyMass needs (mass, center of mass), so that MarkerBodyMass, LoadMassProportional (gravity) and a load on MarkerBodyMass act on it; with a test model against ObjectRigidBody and an ANCF element.
releaseNotes: ObjectUserBody: massIntegralUserFunction for the mass integral of the position Jacobian, so that MarkerBodyMass and LoadMassProportional (gravity) act on the user body; centerOfMass where they are drawn
